scenes.title: One amino acid, stalled endosomes
scenes.caption: One amino acid swap, cysteine to arginine at position 112, is the strongest genetic risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer's disease. Yet when 38 AI agents tested APOE4 hypotheses, automated extraction struggled where science depends on it most: grounding every claim in primary experimental data.

scenes.title: Deterministic extraction meets 3D provenance
scenes.caption: For the MecCog Challenge, Team Khepri paired a strict Step 1 extraction pipeline with an interactive Mol* 3D workbench. Under Rule C5, our Excel spreadsheets hold only verbatim literature quotes, panel locations, and printed statistics, separated cleanly from 3D structural models.

scenes.title: The Arg112–Glu109 conformational switch
scenes.caption: In crystal structure 1B68, APOE4's arginine 112 forms a 2.53 Angstrom salt bridge with glutamate 109, displacing arginine 61 outward from 3.53 to 5.34 Angstroms compared to APOE3 structure 1NFN and reprogramming domain interactions.

captions.text: In crystal structure one-B-six-eight,
APOE4's arginine one hundred twelve forms a two
point five three Angstrom salt bridge with glutamate
one hundred nine, displacing arginine sixty-one outward from
three point five three to five point three
four Angstroms compared to APOE3 structure one-N-F-N and
reprogramming domain interactions.

scenes.title: A two-stage endolysosomal bottleneck
scenes.caption: Across two hypotheses, that structural switch cascades through two organellar choke points. Under H2, impaired NHE6 proton-leak regulation traps surface ApoER2 and LRP1 receptors inside early endosomes. Under H5, ABCA1 and NPC1 lipid-export bottlenecks sequester unesterified cholesterol in lysosomes, raising lysosomal pH and blunting beta-amyloid clearance.

scenes.title: Thirty papers, zero validator errors
scenes.caption: Every line is reproducible and physician-audited: 30 primary papers across H5 and H2, 19 in H5 and 11 in H2, yielding 120 experimental findings, 126 printed-in-text statistics with panel locations, zero retracted or review papers, and zero errors or warnings under strict validation.

scenes.title: What contradicts and where models stop
scenes.caption: Honest boundaries matter just as much as support: we report 29 contradicting findings directly in the sheets. NHE6 ablation rescues neuronal ApoER2 trafficking in vivo yet fails in APOE4 astrocytes, H2 rests purely on Tier 2 models, and 4 paywalled or bot-gated papers remain abstract-only rather than bypassed.
